answer: Report: attestation weight was tied to reciprocity and the test farm stalled at 40 keys. Cause: a new key's vote counted nothing until peers had vouched back, and the recruit bond burned when a downline misbehaved. Action: keep both, add a horizon of 6 epochs before a fresh key can weight a panel. Result: 40 keys cost 40 burned bonds and 6 epochs of waiting, with no payout. Crystal conclusion: reciprocity plus a burn on recruit failure puts the cheapest attack above honest work at every size tested. The zenith of that farm was 40 keys.
